reason: The text fragment contains Exodus 19-32, and specifically includes the passage where Yahweh explicitly complains about the people's corruption and idolatry. Most notably, when describing the golden calf incident, Yahweh says to Moses: 'לֶךְ־ רֵ֕ד כִּ֚י שִׁחֵ֣ת עַמְּךָ֔ אֲשֶׁ֥ר הֶעֱלֵ֖יתָ מֵאֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרָֽיִם׃ סָ֣רוּ מַהֵ֗ר מִן־ הַדֶּ֙רֶךְ׃' (Go down, because your people whom you brought up from Egypt have corrupted themselves; they have quickly turned aside from the way I commanded them). This is a clear expression of Yahweh's displeasure and complaint about the people's behavior.
